_comment: Round 1 (analyst proposal from runs/frozen/print residuals + quotes.csv/SCHEMA.md). Remarks: only tagged request kinds are keywords (mined chatter dropped). Sheets: A-size equivalents and full-sheet counts from the standard sheet yields, as candidate quantities. The engine keeps a term only if more quotes reproduce to the yen.

derived.a4eq: quantity * kinds * if_(size == 'A3', 2, if_(size == 'B4', 1.5, if_(size == 'B5', 0.75, if_(size == 'A5', 0.5, 1))))
derived.sheets: ceil(quantity / if_(size == 'A3', 4, if_(size == 'A4', 8, if_(size == 'B4', 8, if_(size == 'A5', 16, if_(size == 'B5', 16, 1)))))) * kinds
